meta.note: Brand tokens are copied exactly from EdSider's live stylesheet. Review-signal tokens (dup, review, distinct, ok) and the dark theme are additions for the review tools, built on the brand's own accent hues and darkened until text on them reads at 4.5:1.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: EdSider purple (--color-primary). Primary buttons, the active nav item, the accent line of a heading, links, focus rings, and the guard layer (safety-check notes). 9:1 on white.

tokens.name: primary-dark
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of primary buttons (--color-primary-dark).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Active nav pill, section-rail active circle, icon tiles, guard notes (--color-primary-soft). Primary text reads on it.

tokens.name: text-dark
tokens.usage: Headings, body copy and question text (--color-text-dark) on surface, surface-page and surface-sunk.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Subtitles, captions, metadata, inactive nav (--color-text-muted). 7:1 on surface-page in light, 7.5:1 on surface in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, the header bar, inputs (--color-white in the brand).

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page background of the review tools: the brand's faint lavender tint, so white cards sit on it.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: The brand lavender (hero gradient stop). Decision bars, raw-text panels, a shared stem's card.

tokens.name: border-soft
tokens.usage: Card and divider borders (--color-border-soft). Decorative only.

tokens.name: border-outline
tokens.usage: Outline (secondary) button border on the marketing site. 1.3:1 on white: fails the 3:1 control-border floor, kept exact; the review tools use border-strong for controls instead.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes, toggles and secondary buttons in the review tools. 3.7:1 on surface in light, 3.6:1 in dark.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Brand green (--color-success): the Sinhala language pill, success form status. 3.1:1 on white - below 4.5:1 for small text; kept exact from the source. For success text in the review tools use ok.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Sinhala pill and success-status fill (--color-success-soft).

tokens.name: accent-coral
tokens.usage: Coral accent (--color-accent-coral): stat icons, error form status. 3.5:1 on white - icon and large text only; kept exact. dup is its text-safe deepening.

tokens.name: accent-coral-soft
tokens.usage: Coral icon-tile fill (--color-accent-coral-soft).

tokens.name: accent-gold
tokens.usage: Gold accent (--color-accent-gold): stat icons, category tabs. 2.1:1 on white - icons only; kept exact. review is its text-safe deepening.

tokens.name: accent-gold-soft
tokens.usage: Gold icon-tile fill (--color-accent-gold-soft).

tokens.name: accent-blue
tokens.usage: Blue accent (--color-accent-blue): the English language pill, stat icons. 2.9:1 on white - icons only; kept exact. distinct is its text-safe deepening.

tokens.name: accent-blue-soft
tokens.usage: English pill and blue icon-tile fill (--color-accent-blue-soft).

tokens.name: alert-dot
tokens.usage: The small red dot above the hero headline. Decorative only.

tokens.name: dup
tokens.usage: Review signal: Likely duplicate, Repeat on assessment, Exact match, a confirmed duplicate, errors. Coral hue, deepened: 5.7:1 on surface, 5:1 on dup-soft. Always paired with its word.

tokens.name: dup-soft
tokens.usage: Fill for duplicate badges and error notices; dup text reads on it.

tokens.name: review
tokens.usage: Review signal: Needs review (0.85 to 0.92), warnings, a paper awaiting its teacher. Gold hue, deepened: 5.5:1 on review-soft.

tokens.name: review-soft
tokens.usage: Fill for review badges and warning notices; review text reads on it.

tokens.name: distinct
tokens.usage: Review signal: Distinct, Not a duplicate. Blue hue, deepened: 5.9:1 on surface. Blue, not green, so it never relies on red/green to be told apart from dup.

tokens.name: distinct-soft
tokens.usage: Fill for distinct badges; distinct text reads on it.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success notices only (saved, no repeats found, review done). The brand green, deepened: 5.3:1 on surface. Never a similarity verdict.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Fill for success notices and the Reviewed pill; ok text reads on it.

families.heading: "Poppins", "Noto Sans Sinhala", "Noto Sans Tamil", system-ui, sans-serif
families.body: "Inter", "Noto Sans Sinhala", "Noto Sans Tamil", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: --fs-h1 3.1rem, extrabold, line-height 1.18. Marketing hero only; never inside the review tools.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: --fs-h2 2.1rem, extrabold. One page title per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: --fs-h3 1.375rem. Section headers, the paper title on intake.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card and part headers, notice titles.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Stat-card figures and the headline similarity of a pair (.stat-number 1.6rem).

styles.name: pill
styles.usage: Language pills, verdict badges, status pills (.hero-lang-pill .85rem bold).

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Calculate the area of a rectangle 12 cm by 5 cm.
styles.usage: --fs-body-lg 1.05rem, line-height 1.75. Question and answer text - what teachers wrote - and page subtitles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every verdict given on the Find duplicates page.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: --fs-small .875rem medium. Metadata, stat labels, captions, ids (with tabular figures).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Label-to-value gaps inside a pill or stat.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between pills and between buttons (.hero-languages-pills gap).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Icon tile to text in a stat card; label to pills (.stat-card gap, .hero-languages gap).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Grid gap between cards (.stats-row gap).

tokens.name: space-card
tokens.usage: Card padding (.stat-card padding).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Horizontal button padding; below a pill row (.hero-btn, .hero-languages margin).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Below a section subtitle, between page sections (.section-subtitle margin).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Notices, inputs, MCQ option tiles, small icon tiles (.contact-form-status, .cat-item-icon).

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: 48px stat and feature icon tiles (.stat-icon, .why-card-icon).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and pair reviews (--radius-card).

tokens.name: radius-btn
tokens.usage: Buttons (--radius-btn).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Nav items, language, verdict and status pills, the section rail, toggles.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: Resting cards in dense lists: pair reviews, draft cards, question cards.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Stat cards and standalone cards (.stat-card).

tokens.name: shadow-card-hover
tokens.usage: A lifted card on hover, with a 4px rise.

tokens.name: shadow-rail
tokens.usage: The floating section rail.

tokens.name: shadow-primary
tokens.usage: Primary button at rest (.hero-btn-primary).

tokens.name: shadow-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button on hover, with a 2px rise.

tokens.name: gradient-hero
tokens.usage: Peach to lavender. The hero band behind the page title on the landing page; at most one band per review-tool page (the page header).

tokens.name: gradient-hero-deep
tokens.usage: Wider hero variant ending in lilac.

tokens.name: gradient-soft
tokens.usage: Lavender to cream section backgrounds.
